title: Instrument file-change tracking behind 13.8s global state-lock hold
outcome: Greg observed: state lock held 13811ms by src/sse_broadcast.rs:524:36 (wait 0ms), with workspace PUT, mailbox and state accessors waiting 5-11.6s. Holder is record_active_turn_file_changes. It loops sessions/events and calls path_contains -> fs::canonicalize under the global mutex; slow filesystem checks are a candidate, not yet the measured cause. Add aggregate local telemetry separating preparation, acquisition wait, scan/path checks, late-summary construction and commit work; include workload counts and max path-check duration. Emit only slow operations, outside the state lock using bounded nonblocking diagnostics; no raw paths/transcript data. Preserve behavior; do not implement a speculative lock redesign. Related prior stall report tm-7cu.21.
acceptance: Deterministic tests cover timing threshold, workload counters, active/no-summary and grace/commit branches, report after unlock and bounded queue behavior. Slow log distinguishes inclusive scan time from its path-check subset. No release build or live deployment.
